name: RC–B10–0157/2025 – § 5 – Am 29
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text: 5. Denounces the naivety of the Western chancelleries and the European External Action Service towards the abuses committed by the jihadist factions which, having overthrown the regime, are now participating in the government; deplores the fact that several European countries have already resumed contact with these groups, thus giving them undue legitimacy despite their terrorist past and their persistent infringements of fundamental rights; stresses the inconsistency of the interim President’s statements, which cannot disguise the absence of any real guarantees regarding respect for fundamental freedoms; calls on the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy and the Member States to cease any complacency regarding human rights violations in Syria, regardless of the factions responsible, and to show restraint in normalising relations with the new Syrian regime;
